COD.rationale: Content (red positions), an organization/presentation marker (origin/represented_time), and a separate status/origin field are present for the same referent/time.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

A.rationale: Processing-related origin tags and a sentence linking current and conditional candidates are present, but no explicit attention/allocation claim clearly bound to a content's presentation/access is made.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content listings identify specific contents (colour-labelled position sets) with attributes.

D.rationale: Content values (red coordinates) are presented alongside separate origin/status metadata for the same referent, distinguishing identification from presentation/status.

O.rationale: Lines express how content is represented/organized (coordinate sets) together with provenance/representation metadata, indicating presentation/organization/access information.
